name: Household / Family-Unit Composition Agent
description: Household / Family-Unit Composition Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: payer-operations. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Takes a batch of plan members plus a set of pairwise rela...
skills.description: Takes a batch of plan members plus a set of pairwise relationship links (shared subscriber, shared address, a tax-dependent tie) and groups the members into households by computing the connected components of the relationship graph — so a member linked to a member linked to a third all land in one household even when the first and third are not directly linked (transitivity) — reporting the households, the household count, the largest-household size, and the disposition (all-singletons / households-formed). A deterministic payer-operations agent; it COMPLEMENTS the Master-Patient-Index agent (which matches records of the SAME person), the Enrollment Reconciliation agent (WHO is enrolled via a keyed set-difference), and the Coordination of Benefits agent (the ORDER of a member's coverages) — this GROUPS distinct members into family units

skills.name: The grouping is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the re...
skills.description: The grouping is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the request's own members + links (no randomness, no clock; not a percentile, an FSM transition, an edit distance, an interval selection, a bin-packing, a sliding-window count, an interval merge, a topological sort, a set-difference, a dollar waterfall, a pairwise KB lookup, or a hash chain but UNION-FIND / DISJOINT-SET CONNECTED COMPONENTS — the transitive closure of the relationship links); the same members + links always yield the same households, with deterministic household ids (assigned by each component's minimum member)

skills.name: The grouping must be built from the submitted batch — eve...
skills.description: The grouping must be built from the submitted batch — every link must connect two submitted members (no phantom relationship), and the households must PARTITION exactly the submitted members (each member in exactly one household, all covered, none invented); a phantom link or a dropped / invented member is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.household.links-sourced, the sourced + completeness gate); and the partition must be the correct connected components — recomputing the union-find must reproduce the reported households, counts, and disposition; a wrong grouping (two unlinked members merged, or two linked members split) is blocked (policy.household.partition-consistent, the load-bearing correctness gate). Mirrors the Enrollment Reconciliation Agent's reconciliation-complete + the Provider Benchmarking Agent's stats-consistent posture

skills.name: The agent PROPOSES a household grouping — it NEVER merges...
skills.description: The agent PROPOSES a household grouping — it NEVER merges member records, changes enrollment, or applies a family accumulator (each is a consequential action that must be authorized) on its own; a determination that auto-merges or is not review-gated is blocked (policy.household.no-autonomous-merge), and every grouping is confirmed by a data steward. Mirrors the Enrollment Reconciliation Agent's no-autonomous-change and the Master-Patient-Index Agent's no-autonomous-merge posture

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic members + links — cle...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic members + links — clearly labeled; NOT a certified enrollment / MDM system (real household / family-unit composition uses the 834 subscriber / dependent structure, address normalization, tax-household rules, and a master-data-management steward's judgment). PHI-bearing — the members are patients
